questions.question: Describe how streak offer a more dependable clue to mineral identity / than surface colour.
questions.solution_html:
• The color of powder of a mineral as obtained by scratching the surface of the mineral with
  • a knife or file, if the mineral is not too hard, by rubbing it on an unglazed porcelain surface
  • is called the streak. Definition- ((2 marks)). The streak is often very important quality in
  • distinguishing minerals. Streak is an independent property while compared to color. For
  • example- hematite and magnetite are black in color, while their streak cherry red and black
  • in color. - Explanation ((4 marks)). Example ((2 marks))
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Compare rotation and roto-inversion symmetry.
questions.solution_html:
• Rotation symmetry: a symmetry operation where an object is rotated around an axis by
  • specific angle and returns to its original position. ((4 marks))
  • Rotoinversion: A combined symmetry operations involving a rotation followed by an
  • inversion through a center point. -((4 marks))

questions.question: Discuss the role of halides in the chemical industry.
questions.solution_html:
• Halides find their greatest use in the production of sodium compounds and chlorine. Sylvite
  • and other potassium salts are used in fertilizers, as well as in the manufacture of dyes and
  • soaps. Definition with examples- ((3.5 marks)). Large quantities of fluorite are used in
  • metallurgical operations as a flux. Halides are also essential for making plastics such as
  • polyvinyl chloride (PVC) and synthetic rubber. In electronics, halides play an important
  • role in the production of semiconductors and are used in processes like etching and metal
  • coating. They also help control electrochemical reactions and prevent corrosion in various
  • industries. – Uses-((4.5 marks)).
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Compare the geometries of triangular and cuboctahedral coordination / polyhedra.
questions.solution_html:
• Trigonal planar coordination is simple, flat, and involves only three ligands arranged
  • around a central atom in a single plane. Cuboctahedral coordination is complex, three
  • dimensional, and highly symmetrical, accommodating twelve ligands surrounding the
  • central atom in a tightly packed polyhedral arrangement. Explanation ((5 marks)). Figure

questions.question: Compare the retardation values and interference colour effects of / quartz wedge, gypsum plate, and mica plate and classify their applications in mineral identification.
questions.solution_html:
• Explanation about quartz wedge, gypsum plate and mica plate. ((6 marks)). Quartz wedge
  • offers variable retardation, helps in determination of birefringence. Gypsum plate- helps in
  • determination of optical sign. Mica plate- Gives low retardation and it is ideal for weakly
  • birefringence mineral- ((3 marks)). Applications ((3 marks)).
